v2.7.0 Update
🧭 Tooltip side: Choose Automatic, Left, or Right, with automatic fallback when the preferred side lacks room.
📐 Submenu width: Set Action Menu submenus from 280 to 700 pixels; sizing accounts for HUD scale, theme width, and screen edges.
👤 Personal settings: Tooltip and submenu controls are grouped in the Action Menu settings panel and remain available without global style-edit permission.
🐛 Fixes: DnD5e enricher punctuation stays in line, and bundled hover sounds replace removed Foundry click.wav paths.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v2.7.0
announcement.content:
v2.7.0 adds personal Action Menu placement controls and fixes two tooltip issues.

  • Choose Automatic, Left, or Right for tooltips; they switch sides when screen space is limited.
  • Set submenu width between 280 and 700 pixels. Menus account for HUD scale, theme width, and screen edges.
  • Tooltip position, tooltip side, submenu side, and submenu width are grouped in Action Menu settings and available to players as client-only options.
  • DnD5e attack and damage tooltips keep punctuation in line instead of placing . Hit: on a separate line.
  • Action Menu hover sounds use bundled files instead of removed Foundry click.wav paths, preventing 404 errors.
